sources.docker-compose.yml:
name: carddemo

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: carddemo-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: carddemo
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: carddemo
      POSTGRES_DB: postgres
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - carddemo-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./docker/postgres/init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U carddemo -d postgres"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  iam-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/iam-service
    container_name: carddemo-iam
    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: 8081
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: carddemo_iam
      DB_USER: carddemo
      DB_PASSWORD: carddemo
      IAM_TOKEN_SECRET: ${IAM_TOKEN_SECRET:-carddemo-demo-secret-change-me}
      IAM_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS: 3600
    ports:
      - "8081:8081"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  customer-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/customer-service
    container_name: carddemo-customer
    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: 8082
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: carddemo_customer
      DB_USER: carddemo
      DB_PASSWORD: carddemo
    ports:
      - "8082:8082"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  card-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/card-service
    container_name: carddemo-card
    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: 8083
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: carddemo_card
      DB_USER: carddemo
      DB_PASSWORD: carddemo
    ports:
      - "8083:8083"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  account-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/account-service
    container_name: carddemo-account
    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: 8084
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: carddemo_account
      DB_USER: carddemo
      DB_PASSWORD: carddemo
    ports:
      - "8084:8084"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

  transaction-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/transaction-service
    container_name: carddemo-transaction
    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: 8085
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: carddemo_transaction
      DB_USER: carddemo
      DB_PASSWORD: carddemo
      CARD_SERVICE_URL: http://card-service:8083
      ACCOUNT_SERVICE_URL: http://account-service:8084
      MARKETING_SERVICE_URL: http://marketing-service:8087
    ports:
      - "8085:8085"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      card-service:
        condition: service_started
      account-service:
        condition: service_started
      marketing-service:
        condition: service_started

  authorization-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/authorization-service
    container_name: carddemo-authorization
    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: 8086
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: carddemo_authorization
      DB_USER: carddemo
      DB_PASSWORD: carddemo
      CARD_SERVICE_URL: http://card-service:8083
      ACCOUNT_SERVICE_URL: http://account-service:8084
      CUSTOMER_SERVICE_URL: http://customer-service:8082
    ports:
      - "8086:8086"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      card-service:
        condition: service_started
      account-service:
        condition: service_started
      customer-service:
        condition: service_started

  web-ui:
    build:
      context: ./services/web-ui
    container_name: carddemo-web-ui
    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: 8080
      IAM_SERVICE_URL: http://iam-service:8081
      CUSTOMER_SERVICE_URL: http://customer-service:8082
      CARD_SERVICE_URL: http://card-service:8083
      ACCOUNT_SERVICE_URL: http://account-service:8084
      TRANSACTION_SERVICE_URL: http://transaction-service:8085
      AUTHORIZATION_SERVICE_URL: http://authorization-service:8086
      MARKETING_SERVICE_URL: http://marketing-service:8087
    ports:
      - "8090:8080"
    depends_on:
      iam-service:
        condition: service_started
      customer-service:
        condition: service_started
      card-service:
        condition: service_started
      account-service:
        condition: service_started
      transaction-service:
        condition: service_started
      authorization-service:
        condition: service_started
      marketing-service:
        condition: service_started

  marketing-service:
    build:
      context: ./services/marketing-service
    container_name: carddemo-marketing
    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: 8087
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PORT: 5432
      DB_NAME: carddemo_marketing
      DB_USER: carddemo
      DB_PASSWORD: carddemo
      ACCOUNT_SERVICE_URL: http://account-service:8084
    ports:
      - "8087:8087"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      account-service:
        condition: service_started

volumes:
  carddemo-pgdata:

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.3.6</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.carddemo</groupId>
    <artifactId>carddemo-java</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>pom</packaging>
    <name>carddemo-java</name>
    <description>CardDemo 信用卡核心系统的 DDD 微服务实现</description>

    <modules>
        <module>services/iam-service</module>
        <module>services/customer-service</module>
        <module>services/card-service</module>
        <module>services/account-service</module>
        <module>services/transaction-service</module>
        <module>services/authorization-service</module>
        <module>services/marketing-service</module>
        <module>services/web-ui</module>
    </modules>

    <properties>
        <java.version>21</java.version>
        <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <springdoc.version>2.6.0</springdoc.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencyManagement>
        <dependencies>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>org.springdoc</groupId>
                <artifactId>springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui</artifactId>
                <version>${springdoc.version}</version>
            </dependency>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
                <artifactId>flyway-database-postgresql</artifactId>
                <version>${flyway.version}</version>
            </dependency>
        </dependencies>
    </dependencyManagement>

    <build>
        <pluginManagement>
            <plugins>
                <plugin>
                    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                    <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                </plugin>
            </plugins>
        </pluginManagement>
    </build>
</project>

server:
  port: ${SERVER_PORT:8084}
  shutdown: graceful

spring:
  application:
    name: account-service
  datasource:
    url: jdbc:postgresql://${DB_HOST:localhost}:${DB_PORT:5432}/${DB_NAME:carddemo_account}
    username: ${DB_USER:carddemo}
    password: ${DB_PASSWORD:carddemo}
    hikari:
      maximum-pool-size: 10
  jpa:
    open-in-view: false
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: validate
    properties:
      hibernate:
        jdbc:
          time_zone: UTC
  flyway:
    enabled: true
    locations: classpath:db/migration

management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,info,metrics
  endpoint:
    health:
      probes:
        enabled: true
      show-details: never

springdoc:
  api-docs:
    path: /v3/api-docs
  swagger-ui:
    path: /swagger-ui.html
    operations-sorter: method
    tags-sorter: alpha
    display-request-duration: true
    try-it-out-enabled: true
  default-produces-media-type: application/json

logging:
  level:
    com.carddemo: INFO

package com.carddemo.authorization.application;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

/**
 * 授权请求命令（POST /api/v1/authorizations）。除 cardNumber、transactionAmount 外均可选；
 * authTimestamp 缺省为服务端当前时间。
 */
public record AuthorizationCommand(
        String cardNumber,
        BigDecimal transactionAmount,
        String authType,
        String cardExpiryDate,
        String messageType,
        String messageSource,
        String processingCode,
        String merchantCategoryCode,
        String acquirerCountryCode,
        Integer posEntryMode,
        String merchantId,
        String merchantName,
        String merchantCity,
        String merchantState,
        String merchantZip,
        String transactionId,
        LocalDateTime authTimestamp) {
}

package com.carddemo.authorization.domain.model;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

/**
 * 授权请求快照（写入 auth_detail 的请求字段，已解析出账户号与客户号）。
 * 字段与遗留 AUTHFRDS 记录一一对应（docs/legacy/04-data-dictionary.md）。
 */
public record AuthorizationRequest(
        String cardNumber,
        LocalDateTime authTimestamp,
        BigDecimal transactionAmount,
        String authType,
        String cardExpiryDate,
        String messageType,
        String messageSource,
        String processingCode,
        String merchantCategoryCode,
        String acquirerCountryCode,
        Integer posEntryMode,
        String merchantId,
        String merchantName,
        String merchantCity,
        String merchantState,
        String merchantZip,
        String transactionId,
        String accountId,
        String customerId) {
}

package com.carddemo.authorization.interfaces.rest.dto;

import com.carddemo.authorization.domain.model.AuthorizationCase;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

/**
 * 授权明细响应（GET /api/v1/authorizations/{authorizationId}）：请求字段 + 决策 + 商户 + 归属。
 */
public record AuthorizationDetailResponse(
        String authorizationId,
        String cardNumber,
        LocalDateTime authTimestamp,
        String authType,
        String cardExpiryDate,
        String messageType,
        String messageSource,
        String authIdCode,
        String responseCode,
        String reasonCode,
        String processingCode,
        BigDecimal transactionAmount,
        BigDecimal approvedAmount,
        String merchantCategoryCode,
        String acquirerCountryCode,
        Integer posEntryMode,
        String merchantId,
        String merchantName,
        String merchantCity,
        String merchantState,
        String merchantZip,
        String transactionId,
        String fraudFlag,
        String accountId,
        String customerId,
        LocalDateTime createdAt) {

    public static AuthorizationDetailResponse from(AuthorizationCase authorization) {
        return new AuthorizationDetailResponse(
                authorization.getAuthorizationId(),
                authorization.getCardNumber(),
                authorization.getAuthTimestamp(),
                authorization.getAuthType(),
                authorization.getCardExpiryDate(),
                authorization.getMessageType(),
                authorization.getMessageSource(),
                authorization.getAuthIdCode(),
                authorization.getResponseCode(),
                authorization.getReasonCode(),
                authorization.getProcessingCode(),
                authorization.getTransactionAmount(),
                authorization.getApprovedAmount(),
                authorization.getMerchantCategoryCode(),
                authorization.getAcquirerCountryCode(),
                authorization.getPosEntryMode(),
                authorization.getMerchantId(),
                authorization.getMerchantName(),
                authorization.getMerchantCity(),
                authorization.getMerchantState(),
                authorization.getMerchantZip(),
                authorization.getTransactionId(),
                authorization.getFraudFlag(),
                authorization.getAccountId(),
                authorization.getCustomerId(),
                authorization.getCreatedAt());
    }
}

package com.carddemo.customer.domain.model;

import java.time.LocalDate;

/**
 * 客户可维护字段集合，对应遗留 CUSTDAT 记录（copybook CVCUS01Y）的可编辑部分。
 * {@code ssn} 为 null 表示保持不变（PUT 时省略）。
 */
public record CustomerDetails(
        String firstName,
        String middleName,
        String lastName,
        String addressLine1,
        String addressLine2,
        String addressLine3,
        String stateCode,
        String countryCode,
        String zipCode,
        String phoneNumber1,
        String phoneNumber2,
        String ssn,
        LocalDate dateOfBirth,
        String eftAccountId,
        String primaryCardHolder,
        Integer ficoScore) {
}

package com.carddemo.customer.interfaces.rest.dto;

import com.carddemo.customer.domain.model.Customer;

import java.time.LocalDate;

/**
 * BR-CUST-07：SSN 只以 {@code ***-**-1234} 形式返回，永不返回原文。
 */
public record CustomerResponse(
        String customerId,
        String firstName,
        String middleName,
        String lastName,
        String addressLine1,
        String addressLine2,
        String addressLine3,
        String stateCode,
        String countryCode,
        String zipCode,
        String phoneNumber1,
        String phoneNumber2,
        String ssnMasked,
        LocalDate dateOfBirth,
        String eftAccountId,
        String primaryCardHolder,
        Integer ficoScore,
        long version) {

    public static CustomerResponse from(Customer customer) {
        return new CustomerResponse(
                customer.getCustomerId(),
                customer.getFirstName(),
                customer.getMiddleName(),
                customer.getLastName(),
                customer.getAddressLine1(),
                customer.getAddressLine2(),
                customer.getAddressLine3(),
                customer.getStateCode(),
                customer.getCountryCode(),
                customer.getZipCode(),
                customer.getPhoneNumber1(),
                customer.getPhoneNumber2(),
                customer.maskedSsn(),
                customer.getDateOfBirth(),
                customer.getEftAccountId(),
                customer.getPrimaryCardHolder(),
                customer.getFicoScore(),
                customer.getVersion());
    }
}
